trigger: ACCESS EXCLUSIVE (or a long lock) on endpoint_state.endpoints with default pool GUCs (lock_timeout 10 s, statement_timeout 30 s) while operators and clients keep issuing list/REST/viz/MCP roster reads
classification_rationale: Only the pool ACQUIRE is bounded (2 s, 500 ms saturated); the SELECT then holds a lease and an httplib worker for up to lock_timeout/statement_timeout. The banner text "Retry shortly" and 400 ms keyup search re-fire it; the 16-lease pool can fill and starve audit/auth/rbac acquires. Wait is bounded, so not an I5 HIGH case; the same wait existed before and was silent, now user-visible. This change did not add the wait.
